description: Export a node as PNG, SVG, JPG or PDF to disk and return { path, format, scale, bytes }; read the file to view it. outputPath sets the destination; returnBase64: true inlines raw data instead. To see the render in context use figma_screenshot.

outputPath.description: Absolute output path (directories created). Default: auto-named file in the OS temp dir.

returnBase64.description: Return base64 inline instead of a file (rarely useful)

name: figma_export_node
